summary: Gold is only the inherited base sequence (21,22,23,25,26); the injected CMD 24 is correctly left unlabelled because it is a training-data reweighting that is also a no-op. Its anchor ('img_path.with_suffix') is absent and an assert aborts it. The base labels for 21/25/26 (selection on 40 held-out items via the task's own local-eval file) are defensible but borderline, and 23 is an ordinary training run.
